reuse.why: Every step goes through the tree's existing shouldFillCategory / getMonthFillCategories selection and reuses averageToBudgetAmount, getSheetValue and the undoable mutator registration; only the saved-template check parses goal_def locally.

duplication.why: The rules are written once in shouldFillCategory, but the goal_def column and the group-notes JOIN are added to both category queries (getBudgetData and getMonthFillCategories), and the includeHiddenCategories-to-mode ternary is repeated in six actions.

placement.why: The exclusion rules sit in the month-fill selection in budget/actions.ts and the new action is registered beside its siblings; the new helpers are inserted between shouldFillCategory and its doc comment, detaching the comment.

scope.why: Changes match the four steps (rules, new action, #fixed groups, the flag) plus release notes.

maintainability.why: A future exclusion is a single branch in shouldFillCategory; the per-action flag mapping and the two parallel SQL queries are the remaining places that must be kept in step.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth uses shouldFillCategory and every other month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending, uses getMonthFillCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The only repetition (the goal_def/notes JOIN in getBudgetData and getMonthFillCategories, and the includeHiddenCategories ternaries) is open, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldFillCategory gains the template and #fixed rules as general conditions (no caller-specific branches) and the include-hidden flag reuses the existing hiddenMode parameter; each action maps its flag to a mode at the call site rather than bypassing the selection.
